description: This file defines the interface for a factory class that creates internal server implementations of IWebAudioPlayer for the Rialto media server. It includes method declarations for creating WebAudioPlayer instances with specific configurations and references external dependencies such as ISharedMemoryBuffer and IWebAudioPlayerClient.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating internal server WebAudioPlayer instances, inheriting from IWebAudioPlayerFactory.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayer instance for internal server use with specified client, MIME type, priority, configuration, shared memory buffer, and handle.
